studios.name: Squirrel
studios.summary: The racer on its shipped numbers: drift on LT, the Boost Ring on RT, skim rival trails for boost and steal them. Six play-style types over its four element levels.

studios.name: Stoat
studios.summary: The slinger: squeeze a trigger to lay a black-white hole pair and sling round it. Five play styles, five types per setting group, a decision log.
